hooks.name: Graphify: Use knowledge graph for codebase questions
hooks.description: At session start, nudge the agent to use the Graphify knowledge graph for codebase questions instead of raw file reads

action.prompt: If graphify-out/graph.json exists in this workspace, prefer graphify CLI queries (graphify query, graphify path, graphify explain) over grepping or reading files one-by-one for codebase architecture and dependency questions. If the graph doesn't exist yet, suggest running: graphify extract . --code-only && graphify cluster-only . (with GRAPHIFY_BACKEND=none) to build it.
